about_the_game:
Incredible value! Featuring DOUBLE the normal amount of Palia Coins as well as the Greenhouse Herbalist outfit and an exclusive Palcat pet, start your journey off strong in Palia with the Starter Pack!

Includes:
- 850 Palia Coins
- Affectionate Palcat Pet
- Herbalist Greenhouse Outfit

Palia Coins are in-game currency that can be spent in Palia. You can purchase new customization items in the Premium Store!
